checks.legal: CourtListener blocked (known limit); Justia/Alacourt and news-archive legal searches not run (search budget exhausted). Profiles reviewed (Ballotpedia, Auburn Villager, WTVM) mention no legal matters. checks.foreign: FARA: the bulk FARA files (all registrants, short-form registrants, foreign principals) were searched by exact name on 2026-10-13 by the records collector and re-checked here; the loose name matches in that output are other people, and nothing matches this candidate. 2025 House candidate report (paper filing) lists no foreign assets or income. Disclosures: read the filed PDF from the House Clerk (local copy pulled 2026-10-13). Net worth = sum of asset ranges minus sum of liability ranges as filed; a personal residence is not a reportable asset, so a mortgage on it pushes the range down.

note.t: 2025 candidate report, filed on paper (received May 8, 2026). This is a handwritten paper filing; values were read visually from the scanned checkboxes, so ranges are approximate. About 40 holdings worth roughly $1.9M–$4.6M, nearly all exchange-traded funds held in his, his spouse's and joint UBS accounts (Invesco QQQ, SPDR and iShares S&P funds, Vanguard Growth and Value, AB Active ETFs, Invesco BulletShares, iShares I Bonds, iShares Gold), plus UBS deposit accounts and joint accounts at Auburn University, Navy and Tower federal credit unions. One liability: a UBS mortgage (Jan. 2022) of $250K–$500K. Income: his U.S. government pension ($32,664 in 2025), VA disability pension ($7,410), UBS 401(k) withdrawals ($74,699) and his spouse's U.S. government pension ($68,804). No outside positions or agreements; no foreign assets or income.

research_notes: Net worth is approximate (handwritten checkbox form). Courts 'news' rests on one news search that returned nothing about him. Democracy stays 'news'.
